notes.title: Pumpkin Patch 1.0.3 + Modding Added, a few minor bug fixes
notes.content:
Thank you to everyone who is still playing and enjoying Pumpkin Days! We're terribly sorry for the long delay, but we've finally released a version of the game that can modded. The patch notes are:

[b]
PATCH NOTES
[/b]
+ Added signs that say what the shop times are.
+ Coffee seeds are cheaper
+ Fixed cat bringing bugs that don't exist in the game and do nothing.
+ Added more food items that NPCs should like based on their liked and loved the description.
+ Updated recipes that use entire fish for 1 recipe to using the fillets instead. 
+ Modding capabilities added (Please visit Pumpkin Days website for more information)
+ Storage shed is craftable.
+ New Eyebrow types added
+ Fixed jittering when picking up crops in multiplayer
+  Possibly fixed clients not seeing farming quotas in 'farm as rivals' in multiplayer.

Since the development of this game is wrapping up, We will no longer be adding new features or taking any suggestions. Our focus has shifted towards making some parts of the game moddable.


[b]
MODDING PUMPKIN DAYS
[/b]

You can find the Github on how and what can be modded in Pumpkin Days [url=https://github.com/PumpkinDays/Modding]here[/url]. The Github link is also available on our website and on the DIscord as well. For now, you can mod multiple variables used in the data tables in the game. We're going to be hands-off when it comes to the modding community for Pumpkin Days, but if you need help we do have a [url=https://discord.gg/z3QsjVp]#modding channel on our Discord. [/url] 

Examples of things that can be modded include but are not limited to:
- Editing item information such as description and prices
- Editing and adding dialogue
- Changing stats for tools and effects of items
- Changing some npc information
- Translations

Since the game has been out for a while. Anyone who is interested can poke around our data table files or use our dev cheat codes etc. Have fun. 

Please note, that since Pumpkin Days is developed using a 3rd party engine UE4, we can't implement mods as easily as other games with their own systems and we will be restricted to what we can make available. Our next focus is to figure out how to make textures moddable in the game and then we'll wrap up the project.

If you notice any major bugs caused by this patch please let us know ASAP. Thank you again for your support.

notes.title: Pumpkin Patch 1.0.0 + Pumpkin Days is out of Early Access YAY!
notes.content:
TLDR: [i]We're out of early access which is exciting, but we're also out of money for development so there are a few imperfections that we weren't able to fix. All the main features are in, there should be no game-breaking bugs. We're still working on the game and we'll still be putting out pumpkin patches. [/i]


[b]Yay! We're Out of early access![/b]

It's been a long almost 7-year journey developing Pumpkin Days, but we're finally out of early access. [b]Special thank you to everyone who got us to this point.[/b] 

♥ The Kickstarter backers who gave this project legs back in 2014. 

♥ The YouTubers and Streamers who gave us a major visibility boost when the game was out in early access. 

♥ Everyone who hung out and donated on Twitch while we worked on the game. 

♥ The Patreon backers who gave us that extra monthly boost for the past year. 

♥ All freelancers and artists that contributed art, animation, models, music, writing for the game. A special shoutout to the ones who worked with us when our budget was really tight.

♥ Special shout out to Jayden, who programmed the entire game solo and stayed with the project for 6 years.

♥ Thank you Margaret for managing the community and keeping things organized.

♥  Thanks to my partner who helped keep me going when I wanted to curl up into a ball and give up when things got tough.

♥ Thank you to all the players who bought the game in early access even when it was a mess. The sales helped a ton in giving us the budget to make it to this point
 

[b]We still have work to do[/b]

All the main features are implemented, and the bug reports have slowed down quite a bit and so we felt this would be a good time to transition out of early access. However, Pumpkin Days is still not perfect. Given the scope of this project and the size of the team, I'm sure there are things we have missed or things that we wanted to implement but couldn't. We're still going to be polishing the game and fixing issues that are reported when we can.


[b]New price[/b]

Despite the shortcomings of the game, some players have reported hundreds of hours of gameplay and the average hours played between all players is 30 hours. So I hope the new price will be seen as a fair deal and the extra income will help us cover costs to keep working on the game for the next few months.

(Please don't ask us about Steam sales, we're not allowed to say if and when we will put the game on sale before it goes on sale)


[b]How can I help?[/b]

If you want to help push the development of Pumpkin Days a bit further you can. 

1. Buy the game
2. Support us on our [url=https://www.patreon.com/PumpkinDays]Patreon[/url]. There are monthly postcards and stickers of the characters)
3. Gift Pumpkin Days to friends
4. Leave us a positive review if you are enjoying the game. 
5. Make fanart and tell other people about the game.

Thank you once again, everyone. Remember you can always reach out to the developers on [url=https://static.wixstatic.com/media/c052cd_de95ad40eb8d414eb005122beefebcfc~mv2.png/v1/fill/w_332,h_80,al_c,q_85,usm_0.66_1.00_0.01/Discord-Logo-Wordmark-WnC.webp]Discord[/url]. notes.title: 0.4.6 Pumpkin Patch Is out! + Pets Added + News on Final Release
notes.content:
[b]Pumpkin Patch 0.4.6 is out! Pets Added + Optimization[/b]

The main feature of this patch was the addition of pets. Dogs and cats will now spawn randomly in the farm shop. They are a bit rare so if you don't see them the first time you may need to check back. A common question that has been asked is if there is a limit on pets. You can have as many pets as you can fit on your farm. All you need is to have enough space for the pet houses on your plot for each pet. Check the library in the game for more information about how to take care of pets. I forgot to add this in the library, but in case you don't see it before we add it in; different colors of pets spawn in different seasons. There are 7 different colored coats of dogs, and 8 different colored coats of cats.  There really isn't any specific patch notes for this patch. A lot of the fixes were either minor bugs or issues that were rare to trigger. We also did some optimization in the game. We hope that some of these changes will be helpful for some players. 

[b]Please note: [/b]We may have introduced some new bugs that we missed. So if you notice anything odd please let us know as soon as possible so that we can fix them. If you make Pumpkin Days videos or stream Pumpkin Days, I recommend waiting about 3 days after a patch to give us some time to catch and fix any major bugs.

[b]Final Release When?[/b]

The pets were the last major feature to add to the game. So from here on out it's going to be all bug fixes, more writing for the characters, and polish. We still have no set date for when we are coming out of early access, but we are very close, maybe in the next few weeks. Our major challenge is multiplayer related bugs and it's completely unknown how long tackling those bugs will take. Not to mention the community always finds new things we can fix. After we come out of early access, we will still be supporting the game. We're going to keep polishing and improving content when we can. At this point in the game's development (not including unknown bugs) [b]the game is 95% done.[/b]

Thank you so much everyone for your support!

notes.title: Delays with the next pumpkin patch and final release
notes.content:
[i][b]TLDR: [/b]The final release is delayed until November. The next patch will have the kids mechanic which is causing the delay due to debugging. The next patch is possible in a week or some time mid- October.[/i]

[b]Patch delayed but exciting new feature being implemented
[/b]
Hello everyone! It's been a while since our last patch we're hoping that we can patch in about a week, assuming the new system we are implemented on is mostly bug-free. The big feature we are working on that is taking a lot of time are the kids. Some fun mechanics about having kids in the game are:

- Children are dynamically generated using traits from both parents
- Your baby grows into a toddler which then grows into a child.
- Your child can have 1 of  8 different personalities which determine their dialogue
- What you feed your toddler affects their personality. 
- When you leave your farm, your baby and toddler goes in a baby carrier on your back 

So, unlike most farming games, your baby isn't just a cute decoration in your house that stays in the crib forever. In Pumpkin Days your baby will grow up into a walking talking child NPC.
 

[b]Final version of the game being delayed to work on more bug fixes[/b]

We wanted to release the final version of the game this month, but that's not going to happen. Too many bugs that we need time to address and too many incomplete aspects of the game that could use more polish. The final release date is possible in November, but we're not sure. The nice thing about being indie is we can prioritize making sure the game is the best it can be before announcing that it is complete. It would have been cute to release during October because it's Halloween, but we still have some more work to do and the responsible thing to do is to postpone coming out of early access. Sorry again for the disappointment, but:
 
[i]"A delayed game is eventually good. A bad game is bad forever"[/i] ~ Shigeru Miyamoto


So sit tight Pumpkin Days fans, we're still working on the game daily, and once we finally patch there will be a lot of new content for players to explore. 


[b]Note for Pumpkin Days youtube and streamers[/b]

I would also like to add for any youtubers and streamers of Pumpkin Days, I highly recommend waiting at least 3 days anytime we patch before recording or streaming Pumpkin Days. The first few days of the game after a patch usually have game-breaking bugs we didn't account for due to implementing new content. But we're usually good about fixing those up as soon as they are reported. 

 Any questions, comments, or suggestions let us know :). Thank you guys for your support and cheering us on.

notes.title: Latest Hotfixes + Roadmap + FAQs
notes.content:
[b]LATEST HOTFIXES[/b]

It looks like patch 0.3.9 is stable, which means we can start working on the next main feature. If you're not sure what was updated, check the patch notes from the game menu to see the hotfixes. There are also little changes, such as typos, graphical errors etc. that don't make it on the patch notes that were fixed as well. It'll be probably another 4 weeks until we put out version 4.0 which would include marriage in single-player mode as the next main feature.  



[b]VAGUE ROADMAP[/b]

To ensure the quality of the game, we don't rush to meet specific deadlines. Instead, these are just goals we hope to meet assuming development goes smoothly. We're pretty good at staying on schedule even if we don't have a specific date. The goals are as follows:

[b]July[/b]
- Multiplayer fixes and polishes
- Marriage system in (will not be completed because not all the writing and cutscenes will be in)
- Dialogue and cutscene writing

[b]August[/b]
- Kids
- Pets
- Marriage to other players in multiplayer.
- Dialogue and cutscene writing

[b]September[/b]
- Polish and bug fixes
- Dialogue and cutscene writing

[b]October[/b]
- FINAL RELEASE

The main goal is to do the final release of the game in October (That way it'll be thematic with it being pumpkin season)


[b]FAQs[/b]

[b]Should I start the game over?[/b]
I would recommend starting over once we're out of early access to experience all of the changes from the beginning. However, whenever we patch new features they are designed to work seamlessly with older saved games.

[b]Can I get the new features added with the patches with my old save file?[/b]
Yes, except one aspect of the game. Because of how we've set up the dialogue. If you befriend an NPC that doesn't have their dialogue finished yet, you risk skipping dialogue on tiers you've surpassed. Otherwise, everything should work fine.

[b]Is there polyamory in the game?[/b]
Yes. You can currently date multiple characters and we plan to have it so you can marry multiple characters as well.

[b]Will players be able to marry other players?[/b]
Yes. We plan to implement that feature once dating and marriage are stable and bug-free in single-player mode.

[b]Will development be affected by COVID-19?[/b]
Nope, both devs work from home, so it's business as usual.

[b]Will this game be moddable[/b]
Modding is in serious consideration, but it heavily depends on our budget to make aspects of the game moddable. No promises, but we will try our best.


Thank you everyone for your patience. If you have any questions or any bug reports let us know either on our [url=https://discord.gg/z3QsjVp]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/618850/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]

notes.title: How to support Pumpkin Days Development!
notes.content:
Some people have asked how they can further support Pumpkin Days, which if you want to would be great. There are so many amazing suggestions that we would love to do, but can't due to our budget. However, if you want to give us an extra boost of support so that we can maybe add more things, here are some ways you can support us. 

[h3][b]1. Twitch[/b][/h3]
If you are on twitch, we do fundraisers for different things in the game. Currently, we are raising money to get music produced for Diamond Falls. We need a total of 8 songs, 2 for each season.

- 60+ new T-shirt designers
- Spoonie Island and Wahoo Bar Music

[h3][b]2. Patreon[/b][/h3]
Patreon is a service where you support creators by making an automatic monthly donation, in exchange usually for rewards. If you support on the higher tier, I also ask everyone a question every month, which will be turned into an item in-game, in their honor. Here are some examples of things included in the game that were suggested directly from patrons

- New recipes inspired by patrons favorite food 
- New wallpaper inspired by a favorite animal
- Street names for Diamond Falls

[b][url=https://www.patreon.com/PumpkinDays]Check out our Patreon here[/url][/b]

[h3][b]3. Gifting friends Pumpkin Days. [/b][/h3]
A special thanks to those of you who have been buying and gifting the game to friends. Every sale helps boost our budget for development. 


[h3][b]4. Steam Reviews [/b][/h3] [i](A free way to support us)[/i]

Please remember to take a moment to leave us a review on Steam. Especially, If you have been enjoying Pumpkin Days. Reviews are the lifeblood for games on Steam. Personally I don't buy a game on Steam without reading the reviews. So if you have time, provide a thoughtful review that would help someone decide whether not Pumpkin Days is worth buying.

[h3][b]5. Streaming and Youtube Videos [/b][/h3] 
You can make videos or stream Pumpkin Days on Twitch or Youtube. If you are a streamer who already does giveaways to their community and you also stream Pumpkin Days, contact us and you may qualify for some Pumpkin Days steam keys for your community giveaways.

Thank you again so much for your support and playing Pumpkin Days!

notes.title: Lots of News: Bugs, Controller Support, Etc.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34576034/f68fc1e3ab578297bb376b9674af110d6f5f3a9b.png[/img]


[h1][b]Controller Support In Progress[/b][/h1]
(Possibly for the next week)

So some good news! We can plug in a controller, run around in the game and use some of the UI. The bad news is, it is crazy buggy and renders some parts of the game unplayable even without the controller, yikes. This feature will require extensive testing, and during this time we cannot patch the game, but if you guys can hold out for a week we will have controller support!

[h1][b]Slow down on certain bug reports at this time[/b][/h1]

Now I don't want to discourage bug reports, but... we know the animals, trees, and multiplayer are buggy and getting the same reports over and over again is giving me a bit of anxiety knowing that I already wrote them down and we cannot fix them at this time. We're going to make changes to the animal AI so the pooping, building clipping, floating, etc. will be fixed. We're going to do some more tests with multiplayer so we don't get that weird T-pose glitch and other multiplayer bugs.  

All other bug reports are fine, but for animals, trees, and multiplayer, if you see someone mentioning any bugs related to those, please help us out and just let them know, we know about the bugs, we're currently in the middle of a big feature implementation and we will fix them as soon as we're done in roughly 1 week.

[b]If you have an emergency like your game is corrupted, or have a bug renders the game 100% unplayable, definitely always report and let us know[/b] and we would like to troubleshoot with you.

[h1][b]In the meanwhile [/b][/h1]

Now just because we can't make any fresh pumpkin patches doesn't mean that development has slowed down. While Jayden is handling the technical aspects of the game I'm going to use this opportunity to work on other things. I need to polish up models, fix typos, fix clipping, update some graphics, add new furniture, etc. So hopefully the next patch will be a big update. 

In regards to bugs, I hope the community can help other players find workarounds for them, maybe avoid certain features of the game. The Generalsav.sav backups are your best friend etc. 

[h1][b]Chat support added to the website[/b][/h1]

So I'm testing out this new chat support [url=https://www.pumpkin-days.com]on our website[/url] where visitors can chat with me directly (when I'm online). Some players aren't on Discord and that's fine, so here is another outlet to chat with us. I hope no one abuses it, as it's intended to be used if someone has an emergency and needs us to help them out immediately. Any bug reports should just be reported on the forums, discord, or steam community. 

Thank you guys so much for your support. Again, give us about 1 week to get everything sorted out.

notes.title: First Community Update!
notes.content:
Yay, it's our first community announcement. Wow guys, it's been a long journey, but it's happening. We've been quietly developing in our little corner for so long, but this year there should be more activity as we prepare to launch for early access in a few months.

Currently, our page says we are a single-player game. That will be updated before we launch as we take our time and work on getting multiplayer up and running. But for now, that just reflects what we have implemented so far. 

You can find the devs [url=https://discord.gg/z3QsjVp]on discord[/url] if you want to closely follow our development. If you have any questions or comments about Pumpkin Days please feel free to contact us. We're friendly.
